nurse.text: Shwmae, cariad! Croeso, welcome to Swansea Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter. They look like they've walked down from the Beacons in the rain. Twice.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There we are. A cup of tea, a Welsh cake each, and a sit down out of the wind off the bay.
Tidy! All better. Lush, as we say in Swansea. Ta-ra now, mind the gulls on the prom.
The Ark's in the corner, love. It hums a bit when the tide comes in. Nobody knows why.

else.text: No bother at all. Diolch for popping in, that's thank you.
